findings.finding: The draft forwarded raw public credentials while claiming to supersede only RFC 0002, although RFC 0001 also prohibits forwarding originating credentials.
findings.resolution: The RFC now explicitly amends RFC 0001 Goal 4 and RFC 0002 only for the transparent Web API Assistant proxy.

findings.finding: Organization authentication was included although current Assistant handlers do not allow AuthTypeOrg and Assistant production changes were out of scope.
findings.resolution: Organization credential propagation was removed from goals and acceptance criteria and remains a non-goal.

findings.finding: Opaque project and organization keys cannot be matched to Authentication before the downstream call without another trusted binding.
findings.resolution: The RFC requires local comparisons only for user and selected project identifiers. Opaque project keys are independently reauthenticated by Assistant API.

findings.finding: Minting a Web API service assertion as a fallback can replace the originating service actor.
findings.resolution: Service-authenticated proxy calls must forward the validated service assertion and fail closed when it is absent.

findings.finding: Current service assertions use cfg.Port although RFC 0002 and existing tests require RAPIDA_service_id.
findings.resolution: Restoration of RAPIDA_service_id and its tests is included in implementation scope and rollout ordering.
